resources.string: Search files or text inside files…
FastFind needs the \"All files access\" permission to index your phone. The index never leaves your device.
%1$s items indexed • %2$s files with indexed content
Indexing in progress… results will appear gradually

• Several words = all must match: report 2026
• "exact phrase" and -word (exclude)
• ext:pdf or ext:jpg;png
• type:image | video | audio | doc | sheet | slide | archive | apk | code
• size:>10mb or size:1mb..5mb
• modified:today | yesterday | week | month | year
• after:2026-01-01 before:2026-06-30 or modified:7d
• path:Download (part of the path)
• is:folder or is:file
• c:word = search inside file contents
• re:^IMG_\d+ = regular expression on the name

Arabic search ignores diacritics and أ/إ/ا, ى/ي, ة/ه differences, and Chinese works too. If nothing matches, a typo-tolerant search runs automatically (e.g. rprt → report).

Content indexed: text, code, CSV, JSON, HTML, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT and PDF.
